name: JOINT_VISUAL_V1
motivation: After all174 semantic outputs/evaluations and independent reproduction: monotone regularization improves same-head mean KD on both directions, but does not clearly beat strongest C4 KD; C1 per-query shuffling retains much gain. Neural cue input itself has no clear independent gain. Test existing graph plus auxiliary appearance regularization and isolate query-level shifts.
task: Fixed official boxes/IDs accepted by human. Target images, task queries, frozen teacher only; no target manual labels in adaptation.
main_head: Already sealed STRICT_RGB1080 soft400/final mean; no new scalar or head initialization. Same head for KD, GRAPH, CAL and JOINT.
primary: JOINT: existing RGB graph, then the fixed crossfit PAVA odds regularizer from SEMANTIC_COLOUR_V1. No positive guard/nonempty fallback/LoRA.
auxiliary: PAVA maps are exactly the previous teacher-only maps: physical HSV cue, past/current prefix, current TrackID five-fold exclusion, odds cap ln3. Correlated regularization, not independent Bayesian evidence.

raw_methods.CAL: PAVA regularizer on original RGB1080 KD mean, no graph.
raw_methods.JOINT: PAVA regularizer on existing RGB1080 graph mean.
raw_methods.SHUFFLED: Same graph, prior per-query track-permuted auxiliary cue/maps; retains per-query cue marginals.
raw_methods.ROW_SHIFT: Same graph, equal-track mean of real PAVA log-odds correction for each query applied to every track. Preserves within-query score ranking (audit); exclusive joint assignment may still change.
raw_methods.GLOBAL_SHUFFLED: Same graph, cues permuted across all valid query/track cells within family/video before both fitting and prediction; destroys query-level appearance correspondence too.
raw_methods.QUERY_TEACHER: Same graph, per-text teacher-only empirical-Bayes odds: current-fold-excluded/past per-query mean shrunk by two family-prior observations. No colour compatibility values; availability and families shared.
raw_methods.ANCHOR_CAL: Same KD and teacher anchors but no visual edges, then real PAVA. Isolates edges from merely restoring queried labels.
raw_methods.EARLY_GRAPH: Graph on already sealed SEM1081 soft400 scores; robustness control against strong early KD.
raw_methods.EARLY_CAL: Real PAVA on that same SEM400 head.
raw_methods.EARLY_JOINT: Real PAVA after graph on that same SEM400 head.

robustness: Keep all old full-RGB, natural768, zero-HSV, semantic1081 soft/hard checkpoints and prior semantic MONO as strong controls. Do not pick a different primary head by domain. EARLY variants are robustness tests, not an automatic replacement recipe.

countmatched.coarse_scores: Use exact track-level score expansion in memory; avoid duplicating dense score files. Existing KD/graph expansion must equal saved arrays, maps must reproduce prior MONO_ONLY, self-count must be unchanged.

generation: All138 outputs and registered counterfactuals seal before this study target-GT evaluation. CPU quality replay only. No active numerical worker changes once launched.
statistics: Same official HOTA and original-parent / shared-neural-seed descriptive intervals; bootstrap fixed sealed outputs only, no refit per resample or multiplicity correction. Query retrieval and TP/FP/FN diagnosed after seals.
retention: Require independent increments over graph and calibration ablations and face all strong teacher controls. If gains are base-rate/count calibration, say so. No guarantee of positive outcomes, no completion for a queue/report.
cost: Paid source and teacher streams reused. CPU component receipts only; any retained final recipe still needs matching physical single-method cold measurement.
